name: cse-mcp
description: Live Colombo Stock Exchange (Sri Lanka) prices, indices, sectors and announcements for Claude.
long_description:
Ask Claude about the Colombo Stock Exchange and get answers built on live data from the public cse.lk API: market status, ASPI and S&P SL20, top movers, any stock's price and history, sector indices, foreign flows, and company announcements with PDF links.

Unofficial and not affiliated with the Colombo Stock Exchange. Market data, not investment advice.
